description.value: Odd Burger is Canada's first fully vegan fast-food chain, serving plant-based burgers and meals made from scratch using minimally processed, sustainable ingredients. The Victoria location sits at 790 Fisgard Street in the downtown core, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the city centre. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible, dine-in, and offers takeout with no drive-through.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: bollard (4 spaces, covered) at 22m. Total: 4 spaces.
